experiment.name: hybrid
experiment.description: BM25 (sparse vectors in Qdrant with IDF), dense retrieval with the baseline and the best model from #13, and reciprocal rank fusion (k = 60, 100 candidates per side) of the two, on structural chunks of 1,000 characters. BM25 runs with a plain analyzer and with terms cut to their first five characters, a crude stemmer for Turkish suffixes.
